task: The experiment "apple_pay_copy test" in Production is set up but not running. Start it.
finalText: DONE: no change made. In Production, "apple_pay_copy" already has its experiment live: the `experiment-14-rollout` segment override is enabled and splits variant `b` at 50%. SDK evaluation confirmed it (7 of 10 test identities got "Pay securely"). The admin API doesn't list that segment, so it may be in an odd state, which is worth a look.

flagsmith api api/v1/projects/76/features/291/ 2>&1 | jq .; echo ---; flagsmith -e [env-ee04ab7c552fa318] flag get apple_pay_copy 2>&1; echo ---; flagsmith -e [env-ee04ab7c552fa318] flag list 2>&1

flagsmith project --help | sed -n 1,20p; flagsmith segment --help | sed -n 1,15p; flagsmith segment list 2>&1; flagsmith feature variant list apple_pay_copy 2>&1; flagsmith feature variant list --help | head -5

base=http://host.docker.internal:8300; curl -s $base/ | grep -o 'src="[^"]*\.js"' | head; for u in $(curl -s $base/ | grep -o 'src="[^"]*\.js"' | sed 's/src="//;s/"$//' | head -5); do curl -s "$base$u" | grep -o '.\{80\}experiment.\{80\}' | head -5; done

python3 - <<'EOF'
import urllib.request,re
b="http://host.docker.internal:8300"
h=urllib.request.urlopen(b+"/").read().decode()
js=re.findall(r'src="([^"]+\.js)"',h)
print(js[:10])
for u in js:
    try:
        s=urllib.request.urlopen(u if u.startswith("http") else b+u).read().decode()
    except Exception as e: print(e); continue
    for m in set(re.findall(r'.{0,60}xperiment.{0,60}',s))[:0] if False else list(set(re.findall(r'.{0,60}xperiment.{0,60}',s)))[:8]:
        print(u, '|', m)
EOF
